item.title: LP Giobbi, Steve Angello, Bob Moses & More Set to Headline We Belong Here in Central Park
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the provided article:
[Upbeat music plays in the background]
Host: "Hey music lovers! If you're looking for a great way to spend your October, we've got some exciting news for you. The Central Park edition of We Belong Here is back for its third year, and the headliners have just been announced!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "On Friday, October 2, get ready for live sets from MEDUZA³ and LP Giobbi, who'll be playing a special sunset hour show. The next day, Saturday, October 3, will feature Ben Böhmer and Stephan Bodzin taking the stage. And on Sunday, October 4, Steve Angello and Bob Moses will close out the weekend with a DJ set."
[Short music transition]
Host: "But that's not all - the lineup also includes Ashibah, Eve Lauren, and Tripolism, with many more artists to be announced in the coming months. And the best part? You can register for ticket presales right now!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "We Belong Here will be taking over the iconic Wollman Rink in Central Park, which will transform into an ice skating rink just a few weeks after the event. And if you can't make it to New York, don't worry - We Belong Here is also hosting events in New Orleans and Miami, with some amazing lineups planned."
[Music and host continue for another 2 seconds before fading out]
Host: "That's all for now. Get ready to groove, and we'll catch you at We Belong Here!"
